scripts.electron:serve: wait-on tcp:4200 && npm run electron:serve-tsc && npm-run-all -p electron:serve-tsc:watch electron:start
scripts.e2e: npm run build:prod && playwright test -c e2e/playwright.config.ts e2e/
scripts.custom:start-server-and-e2e-electron: npm run custom:clean-testground && npx gulp utils:start-server-and-e2e-electron
scripts.custom:start-server-and-e2e-electron-gre: npm run custom:clean-testground && cross-env "E2E_GREP=pick-up and display" npx gulp utils:start-server-and-e2e-electron
scripts.custom:start-server-and-e2e-electron-scr: npm run custom:clean-testground && cross-env "E2E_GREP=docs screenshots" npx gulp utils:start-server-and-e2e-electron
scripts.custom:start-server-and-e2e-electron-env: npm run custom:clean-testground && cross-env "E2E_GREP=Visualizations" "E2E_ONLY=EF" npx gulp utils:start-server-and-e2e-electron
scripts.custom:start-server-and-e2e-web: npm run custom:clean-testground && npx gulp utils:start-server-and-e2e-web
scripts.custom:e2e-docker: npm run custom:clean-testground && npx gulp e2e-package-javastuff-if-needed && cross-env TEST_ENV=web E2E_BASE_URL=http://localhost:9090 TEST_LICENSE_KEY=51b0aa18f2bbc066efdca8b53c2dacc8 RUNNING_IN_E2E=true PORTABLE_EXECUTABLE_DIR=testground/e2e playwright test -c e2e/playwright.config.ts e2e/
scripts.custom:compile-and-stage-backend-jars: cd ../../bkend/common && mvn clean install -DskipTests && cd ../reporting && mvn clean install -DskipTests && cd ../server && mvn clean install -DskipTests && cd ../../frend/reporting && npx shx cp ../../bkend/common/target/rb-common.jar testground/e2e/lib/burst/rb-common-%npm_package_version%.jar && npx shx cp ../../bkend/reporting/target/*.jar testground/e2e/lib/burst && npx shx cp ../../bkend/server/target/rb-server.jar testground/e2e/lib/server/rb-server.jar && npx shx cp ../../bkend/common/target/rb-common.jar ../../asbl/target/package/verified-db-noexe/DataPallas/lib/burst/rb-common-%npm_package_version%.jar && npx shx cp ../../bkend/reporting/target/*.jar ../../asbl/target/package/verified-db-noexe/DataPallas/lib/burst && npx shx cp ../../bkend/server/target/rb-server.jar ../../asbl/target/package/verified-db-noexe/DataPallas/lib/server/rb-server.jar
scripts.custom:compile-and-stage-web-components: npm --prefix ../rb-webcomponents run build && npx shx rm -rf src/assets/web-components/* && npx shx cp -r ../rb-webcomponents/dist/* src/assets/web-components/ && npx shx mkdir -p testground/e2e/tools/rb-webcomponents && npx shx cp -r ../rb-webcomponents/dist/* testground/e2e/tools/rb-webcomponents/ && npx shx mkdir -p ../../asbl/target/package/verified-db-noexe/DataPallas/tools/rb-webcomponents && npx shx cp -r ../rb-webcomponents/dist/* ../../asbl/target/package/verified-db-noexe/DataPallas/tools/rb-webcomponents/
scripts.custom:stage-apps-frend-grails-testgroun: npm run custom:compile-and-stage-web-components && docker run --rm --entrypoint rsync -v %cd%/../..:/data eeacms/rsync -av /data/asbl/src/main/external-resources/db-template/_apps/ /data/frend/reporting/testground/e2e/_apps/
scripts.custom:stage-apps-cms-wordpress-testgrou: npm run custom:compile-and-stage-web-components && docker run --rm --entrypoint rsync -v %cd%/../..:/data eeacms/rsync -av /data/asbl/src/main/external-resources/db-template/_apps/ /data/frend/reporting/testground/e2e/_apps/
scripts.custom:start-javano-chocono-and-ui: npx gulp e2e-package-javastuff-if-needed && npx gulp utils:start-javano-chocono-and-ui
scripts.custom:start-javano-chocoyes-and-ui: npx gulp e2e-package-javastuff-if-needed && npx gulp utils:start-javano-chocoyes-and-ui
scripts.custom:start-java8-chocono-and-ui: npx gulp e2e-package-javastuff-if-needed && npx gulp utils:start-java8-chocono-and-ui
scripts.custom:start-java8-chocoyes-and-ui: npx gulp e2e-package-javastuff-if-needed && npx gulp utils:start-java8-chocoyes-and-ui
scripts.custom:start-java17-chocono-and-ui: npx gulp e2e-package-javastuff-if-needed && npx gulp utils:start-java17-chocono-and-ui
scripts.custom:start-java17-chocoyes-and-ui: npx gulp e2e-package-javastuff-if-needed && npx gulp utils:start-java17-chocoyes-and-ui
scripts.custom:clean-output: rimraf dist && rimraf release && rimraf testground
scripts.precustom:icons-iconmaker: ie4uinit.exe -ClearIconCache && ie4uinit.exe -show && rimraf testground/fontawesome2png && font-awesome-svg-png --icons paper-plane-o --color steelblue --sizes 1024 --dest testground/fontawesome2png
scripts.custom:test-jasmine: rimraf testground/upgrade && cross-env PORTABLE_EXECUTABLE_DIR=testground/upgrade SHOULD_SEND_STATS=false ts-node -r tsconfig-paths/register --project e2e/tsconfig.e2e.json node_modules/jasmine/bin/jasmine --config=scripts-dev/jasmine/jasmine-updater-all.json
scripts.precustom:release-electron: npm run custom:compile-and-stage-web-components && npm run custom:clean-output && npm prune --force
scripts.custom:e2e-prepare-letmeupdate-for-manua: custom:clean-testground && npx gulp e2e-package-javastuff-if-needed && cross-env PORTABLE_EXECUTABLE_DIR=testground/upgrade SHOULD_SEND_STATS=false ts-node --project e2e/tsconfig.e2e.json node_modules/jasmine/bin/jasmine --config=scripts-dev/jasmine/jasmine-updater-letme.json && npx gulp e2e-copy-dbexe-to-letme-baseline
scripts.custom:e2e-prepare-updatenow-for-manual-: custom:clean-testground && npx gulp e2e-package-javastuff-if-needed && cross-env PORTABLE_EXECUTABLE_DIR=testground/upgrade SHOULD_SEND_STATS=false ts-node node_modules/jasmine/bin/jasmine --config=scripts-dev/jasmine/jasmine-updater-now.json && npx gulp e2e-prepare-updatenow-for-manual-testing
scripts._custom:e2e-generate-let-me-update-basel: rimraf testground && mkdirp testground/upgrade && cross-env PORTABLE_EXECUTABLE_DIR=testground/upgrade ts-node --project e2e/tsconfig.e2e-baseline.json e2e/utils/baseline.ts
scripts._custom:ng:serve:electron: cross-env TARGET=electron NODE_ENV=development NG_DEBUG=verbose ng serve --verbose
scripts._custom:debug:electron: cross-env TARGET=electron NG_VERBOSE=true DEBUG=* ng serve --verbose
scripts._custom:start-server: npx gulp e2e-package-javastuff-if-needed && npm run custom:compile-and-stage-backend-jars && npm run _custom:compile-server && npm run custom:start-server
scripts._custom:start-ui-electron: cross-env NG_DEBUG=true ENABLE_DEVELOPMENT_FEATURES=true PORTABLE_EXECUTABLE_DIR=testground/e2e npm-run-all -p _custom:ng:serve:electron electron:serve
scripts._custom:start-ui-electron-local: cross-env NG_DEBUG=true ENABLE_DEVELOPMENT_FEATURES=true PORTABLE_EXECUTABLE_DIR=testground/e2e npm run electron:local
scripts._custom:playwright-scripts-electron: npm run build:prod && cross-env TEST_ENV=electron TEST_LICENSE_KEY=51b0aa18f2bbc066efdca8b53c2dacc8 RUNNING_IN_E2E=true PORTABLE_EXECUTABLE_DIR=testground/e2e playwright test -c e2e/playwright.config.ts e2e/
scripts._custom:playwright-tests-web: wait-on tcp:4201 && cross-env TEST_ENV=web TEST_LICENSE_KEY=51b0aa18f2bbc066efdca8b53c2dacc8 RUNNING_IN_E2E=true PORTABLE_EXECUTABLE_DIR=testground/e2e playwright test -c e2e/playwright.config.ts e2e/
